Add Probably Weather to your home screen Not now Install

modal.text: Install in 3 steps × 1 Tap Chrome's Share button, next to the address bar 2 Scroll, tap Add to Home Screen 3 Tap × above to close these instructions Probably Weather will appear on your home screen — tap the icon to open the app. Don't see Add to Home Screen? Tap Edit Actions at the bottom of the Share menu and turn it on.
